title: Sales and Marketing ask their own teams, and answer with a capped list or checked terms instead of a permanent blocker
request: Package T3 of the team workspace plan: Sales and Marketing were placeholders (Sales always blocked on 'the call capacity is not on record'; Marketing had no rules, so a question for it stayed open for ever). Make both real deterministic agents: Sales reads the dated do-not-contact list, asks a member of the Sales team for the call capacity (0 to 30) and returns a call list capped at it as a restricted reference, counts only; Marketing asks a member of the Marketing team for the offer's amount, budget, dates and eligibility and returns them checked, or a blocker naming what is missing. A member's answer is recorded as theirs, once; someone outside the team cannot answer; a member removed before delivery blocks the reply; Sales and Marketing work independently; words that could answer two open tasks answer none; an agent with no rules says 'unsupported' at once.
spec: dclab-core 0.170.0 (no shape change): team_work.DIRECTORY marketing.confirm_terms bound to human:marketing_team (was human:marketing_owner), descriptions of ask_capacity and confirm_terms. dclab_rnd: new teamspace/commercial.py (ACCOUNTS fixture counts, ASKS, capacity_of, terms_of, team_has_members, awaiting, refused_at_delivery, act for the six commercial tools, the sales and marketing rules, open_asks, hint, answer); teamspace/tools.py (COMMERCIAL_ACTS, own_team_binding, post_own to_team, _responder and _clarify for an own-team question, _act hands commercial tools to commercial.act; check_exclusions moved out); teamspace/agents.py (Sales and Marketing from commercial, _unsupported, askable, OPEN_ACTIONS per team, from_thread with task_id and response_id: Sales/Marketing threads, several asks from one Business thread, the which-task question, deliver answers an unsupported task at once); teamspace/threads.py deliver (the delivery-time refusal); agentic/api_models.py TeamMessagePost task_id and response_id; agentic/routers/team_threads.py (the message keyed by response_id, both passed to the agent); agentic/web/src/views/team.html (Answer this / Answer <task> buttons, Escape, a response id kept until sent).
plan: make the own-team question a first-class human binding: asked in the agent's own thread, the task stays accepted, nothing travels to the requester
compute the six commercial tools in one module, each recorded under its retry key like every action
write the Sales and Marketing rules over the stored task, resumable after a crash with the same answer
route a member's message in a Sales or Marketing thread to the question its agent asked, by task id when several are open
refuse at delivery a reply resting on a member no longer in the team
answer a task for an agent with no rules with an unsupported blocker
tests on files and PostgreSQL, one route test, the frontend rebuilt

decisions.decision: the member's answer feeds the next step through the subject's response id (capacity-18@m-s-1), not a stored copy of their words
decisions.why: the words stay in the team's own thread; the action records carry only the number or the checked term, and a retry with the same response is the same action id

decisions.decision: a Marketing report carries no evidence row; the checked actions and the restricted reference are its record
decisions.why: team_work refuses evidence from a source outside the task's allowed inputs (tables), and calling a member's answer a table would misattribute it

decisions.decision: without a team of the kind to ask, Sales keeps its old blocker naming who supplies the capacity
decisions.why: the Lead walkthroughs (test_lead_workspace) run without teams and rely on that blocker; asking nobody would hang the task

decisions.decision: words that could answer two open tasks answer none; the agent posts one 'which task?' message with a button per task
decisions.why: guessing the most recent question silently attaches a capacity to the wrong week

decisions.decision: agents.confirm_outcome (T1) is not wired to a route here
decisions.why: its caller is the person's Business thread after an answer, not a Sales or Marketing thread; left for T5b with its own test

change: dclab_core/team_work.py (DIRECTORY rows of sales.ask_capacity and marketing.confirm_terms), dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md (T3 bullet under 0.170.0); dclab_rnd/teamspace/commercial.py (new), tools.py, agents.py, threads.py; dclab_rnd/agentic/api_models.py, routers/team_threads.py, web/src/views/team.html (static/app rebuilt by make web); tests/test_team_commercial.py (new, files and PostgreSQL), tests/test_teamspace_routes.py (one route test).

findings.defect: a resend of the same answer after a crash could not resume
findings.scenario: the capacity is recorded, the turn dies before the list is drafted; the member's client resends the same response id
findings.cause: awaiting() only listed tasks whose own-team question was still running, so open_asks no longer found the task
findings.fix: awaiting() returns an answered question as resume until the final step (return_restricted_ref, return_conditions) is claimed

findings.scenario: omid gives full terms; every check succeeds; team_return_report fails
findings.cause: its evidence named 'the Marketing team's answer' as a source, and the task allows only its sample as an input
findings.fix: no evidence row; the provenance is a limit and the restricted reference

findings.defect: the PostgreSQL run failed on team membership
findings.cause: a team's member must be an account there
findings.fix: the test creates accounts on PostgreSQL, plain ids on files

findings.defect: a resent answer could land on a task opened since
findings.scenario: Raha's '18' (response r1) finishes task A; Business opens B; her browser resends r1; the route saw no new message but still called the agent, which picked B
findings.cause: from_thread picked among the tasks open now; the route also passed the resend's words, not the saved message's
findings.fix: the route passes resend=not made and message['text']; on a resend only a task that already recorded that response by that person resumes (_answered_with), in Sales, Marketing and Business threads
findings.test: test_a_resent_answer_never_lands_on_a_task_opened_since; the route test resends other words with the same response id

findings.defect: most crashes left a Sales or Marketing task stuck
findings.scenario: a crash between two Marketing checks, or after the list, or between writing the question (running) and posting it
findings.cause: resume covered only the window before the first step; a running question was never posted again
findings.fix: resume until the final step; a running question with no answer in the turn is asked again once per turn (_ask_again; tools._clarify reuses the running attempt and its post is keyed)

findings.defect: a refused Sales reply still reached the Lead's joined report
findings.scenario: the Lead routes to Data Science and Sales; Raha answers 18; she is removed; Data Science replies; the Lead joins 'Sales can make 18 calls'
findings.cause: the refusal stopped only the thread post; _join reads stored child reports
findings.fix: commercial.answer_withdrawn, read at delivery and in _join: such a report is not joined, the parent is partial and names Sales

findings.defect: 'budget EUR 1,000' was read as EUR 1 and reported complete with 0 offers funded
findings.scenario: a member writes the budget with a thousands separator
findings.fix: groups of three after a comma or point are thousands, a last group of one or two digits cents; a budget funding no offer is a blocker

findings.defect: Sales took the first number as the capacity
findings.scenario: '2 of us are off, so 18' became 2
findings.cause: capacity_of read the first whole number
findings.fix: only a single distinct number is read; several get the hint

findings.defect: a client's response id named an ask across threads and people; the page reused an id across asks; reply buttons showed on an agent's own copy of a question sent elsewhere
findings.fix: the ask's task id is a digest of thread, person and response id; the page's pending id includes the ask; reply buttons only where the question is for the thread's team
findings.test: route and agent tests; the page by build --check
findings.scenario: a client's response id named an ask across threads and people; the page reused an id across asks; reply buttons showed on an agent's own copy of a question sent elsewhere
findings.cause: a client's response id named an ask across threads and people; the page reused an id across asks; reply buttons showed on an agent's own copy of a question sent elsewhere

outcome: Sales and Marketing answer real questions in their own threads. A capacity of 18 gives '18 of the 102 eligible accounts' as a restricted reference; 0 is a blocker; a full set of terms gives 'EUR 10 an offer; a budget of EUR 1000 funds 100 offers'; a missing budget is named. Not committed.
lessons: a question an agent asks its own team is not a clarification to the requester: it must not move the task to waiting_for_person or travel back
an idempotent answer needs both a message key and an agent path that can still find the task after the answer was recorded
an idempotency key on a message is not enough: a resend must resume only the work that already took that key, never pick again among what is open now
risks: the capacity and terms are read with regular expressions; unusual phrasings are refused with a hint rather than guessed
ACCOUNTS is an invented fixture; a real Sales table is not read yet
a crash between recording the answer and the next step resumes only when the same response id is sent again
the requester can still read a withdrawn report on its task page (read_team_task); only joining and delivery refuse it
